item.title: James Tildsley, Nick DeSisto pin down New England wrestling titles
item.description: James Tildsley and Nick DeSisto accomplished two things Sunday in Providence, R.I. First, they cemented their reputations as all-time great local wrestlers. Two, they captured New England championships. Tildsley, a Shawsheen Tech senior, ruled the 157-pound field. DeSisto, a Tewksbury High senior, captured the 126-pound crown. Tildsley is now a rare three-time New England champion. […]

item.title: Written in Granite: Potholes make for a bumpy road
item.description: It's been a wild winter in Southern New Hampshire. Just ask Nashua's Department of Public Works crews, who have been plowing up to 765 lane miles of city streets during these frequent snow events.
